trial_a_decision: REVISE: actual welded shoulder continuity improved, but jagged material edges and excessive frontal crown spread prevented acceptance as-is.
reverted_trial_a_choices: Excessive crown lateral spread replaced from exact R1 coordinates with a smaller lens-section deformation
Hard transferred material edges replaced by local interpolation on the same continuous shoulder mesh

trial_b_findings.SIDE: Shoulder-to-upper-arm overlap ledge is reduced and the shoulder/scapula flows into the chest surface. Small head, slender waist, long legs and swept crown profile remain. Shoulder mass still has overly smooth/oval planes relative to the reference.
trial_b_findings.FRONT: Each crown now shows a midsection face width and tip taper rather than two thin near-parallel lines. Trial A spread has been reduced. Shoulder width is less bulbous and integrated into the arm. White/graphite boundary is smoother but too soft for final reference matching.
trial_b_findings.FRONT34: Separate upper-arm cap is replaced by a continuous welded transition. Crown retains two rear-flowing blades and Cue Band clearance. Shoulder surface, white/dark design boundary and local seam fairing still require refinement.

remaining: Refine shoulder/chest planes and white/graphite boundary to canonical facet language
image_method: Actual Cycles renders with matching R1 camera matrices, lighting, seed and color management; no image generation or geometry retouch.
